# ADR-0013: One node per store and one coordinator for the lab

Recorded: 11 October 2026. Retrospective project decision; not a bank governance approval.

## Status

Accepted lab scope; production HA explicitly excluded

## Context

The user requested a small development proof of concept rather than a full product deployment.

## Decision

Run four independent start-single-node CockroachDB containers and one API/coordinator worker. Preserve regional/service interfaces as extension points. Offer an explicit mdm-compact configuration with two independent SG and UK single-node stores. Suspend US, India, migration, the legacy federation worker and telemetry without changing store bindings or deleting volumes. Full remains the default configuration.

## Alternatives

A production HA fleet immediately; one shared database pretending to enforce physical geography.

## Consequences

Geography is a label on one host. Single-node loss causes unavailability. In-process locks do not establish distributed fencing, and no HA/physical-residency claim follows. Compact is sufficient for source MDM and UK servicing demonstrations, not complete US exclusion, India migration, telemetry or recovery acceptance. Suspended-destination work remains durable and is filtered before the active relay batch limit to prevent starvation. Restoring the full configuration resumes current-policy reconciliation.

## Evidence

compose.yaml; poc/Dockerfile; docs/DEVELOPMENT.md

## Gate

Build pilot cells across local failure domains and validate actual placement, identity and distributed authority. Separately execute compact SQL/OPA, command/audit, suspended-work fairness, actual two-store count and restart tests. Run the preserved four-store acceptance before compact acceptance and verify the volume inventory is unchanged.
